name: ninety
description: Connect Claude to Ninety.io: To-Dos, Rocks, Issues, Scorecard, Meetings, Headlines, V/TO, and more.
long_description: Full coverage of Ninety's public API (api.public.ninety.io): create, read, update, and delete To-Dos, Issues, Rocks, and Milestones; read Team Scorecards with score values and write scores, notes, and per-period goals; comments and To-Do linking; Meetings (next and history), Headlines and Cascading Messages, the V/TO, the Accountability Chart, Teams, and Users. Authenticates with your Ninety Personal Access Token (User Settings → Developer Settings in Ninety). Automatic retry on rate limits.

api_token.title: Ninety Personal Access Token
api_token.description: Generate at app.ninety.io → User Settings → Developer Settings. Leave blank if you already saved a token with the terminal auth command.
